newsitem.title: MEXICO: Modelo says sees higher sales this year.
newsitem.headline: Modelo says sees higher sales this year.

text.p: Mexican beer company Grupo Modelo S.A. said on Wednesday it sees domestic sales volume rising 3.5 percent this year versus last year.
It also said it sees export volume rising between 23 and 25 percent compared to last year's levels.

"We raised our initial estimate for domestic sales growth to 3.5 percent from two percent and our estimate for exports to between 23 and 25 percent from 18 percent," said Eduardo Rojo y de Regil, director of investor relations, in a telephone interview with Reuters.
